title: linaria supina subsp. propinqua
intro: Linaria supina subsp. propinqua, commonly known as the small toadflax or small toad-flax, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, digestive issues, and inflammation, due to its health benefits of relieving coughs, sore throats, and fever. The therapeutic actions of Linaria supina subsp. propinqua include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
